description: Implementation of BusinessEventNotifierService handling event notification, external posting, and transaction management within the Fineract project.

classes.name: BusinessEventNotifierServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class managing business event notifications, external posting, and transaction integration.

classes.name: BusinessEventWithContext
classes.description: Inner class encapsulating a BusinessEvent with its associated FineractContext.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initialization logic, logs whether external event posting is enabled.

methods.name: notifyPreBusinessEvent
methods.description: Notifies pre-event listeners and throws if event is bulk.

methods.name: addPreBusinessEventListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for a specific pre-event type.

methods.name: notifyPostBusinessEvent
methods.description: Notifies post-event listeners and handles external event posting if applicable.

methods.name: addPostBusinessEventListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for a specific post-event type.

methods.name: stopExternalEventRecording
methods.description: Stops recording and posts recorded events, either singly or as bulk.

methods.name: resetEventRecording
methods.description: Resets event recording state and clears recorded events.

methods.name: afterBegin
methods.description: Initializes transaction-specific event list at transaction start.

methods.name: beforeCommit
methods.description: Posts transactional events before commit, managing context switching.
